verdict.rationale: Keycloak's Server Administration Guide documents a built-in Organizations section where admins create realm-unique organizations, and realms act as isolated tenants. A community user also reports running it in production as a multi-tenant SSO solution. Only organization creation is evidenced, so the membership and invitation parts of the story are not demonstrated. Missing for 10: documented organization membership management, invitation flows, B2B org-to-IdP linking details, independent hands-on corroboration of the organizations feature.
